migracao.titulo: Move your board to your account?
migracao.texto_one: We found 1 task saved in this browser, from when you used Kanguin without an account. Do you want to move it to your account? That way it's saved in the cloud and shows up on any device.
migracao.texto_other: We found {{count}} tasks saved in this browser, from when you used Kanguin without an account. Do you want to move them to your account? That way they're saved in the cloud and show up on any device.
migracao.nota: Your team and trash come along too. If you choose "Not now", everything stays in this browser and shows up when you sign out.
